author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing the Schluter linear drain grate frame using ALL-SET. The height can be adjusted based on the shower floor tile thickness. Ideally the tile is even or slightly higher than the grate frame so that water will drain properly. The color of the drain grate matches the DESIGN-NICHE and corner shelves that will be installed in this shower
title: Schluter Linear Drain Grate Installation Tips - #shorts #showerremodel #sponsored
